text:
The pasture land passes to Tommy under Bill’s will, while the condominium passes outside probate to Kathy by survivorship as the surviving tenant by the entirety; her prenuptial waiver does not undo that completed inter vivos conveyance. All other assets pass equally to Tommy and Julie, and Kathy receives no additional pretermitted-spouse or intestate share because she validly waived those rights.  
CONFIDENCE: 98
